name: Teaparty Countdown
source:
You play as yourself, late for the Lolita Meet Up of the Century and you only have a few minutes to throw together an outfit. Race against the clock to make it in time for the party without looking... ita!

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/teaparty.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
你扮演你自己，在世纪洛丽塔聚会中迟到了，你只有几分钟的时间来搭配一套衣服。与时间赛跑，在不看的情况下及时赶到聚会…… ita！

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/teaparty.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
